task.prompt: Show me the screen of the frames in which the blitter fired during the boot, before anything was armed in this session to keep them.

lines: m120: CANNOT No tool can show frames from before a film or blit capture was armed; nothing was kept for the boot.
m120: CANNOT Nothing was armed during the boot, and a film keeps only frames judged after it is armed; earlier frames are not recorded.
m120: CANNOT No film was armed during the boot, and gfx_film keeps frames only from when it is armed.
m120: CANNOT Nothing was armed before this session to keep blitter frames, and gfx_blits needs a recorded draw_command capture that does not exist for the boot.
m120: CANNOT Film and blit captures only keep what was armed before the frames ran, so nothing from boot can be shown now.
m120: CANNOT gfx_film keeps only frames from when it is armed, so frames during the boot before anything was armed cannot be recovered.
m120: CANNOT No film was armed before the boot, so the server kept no frames from it, and the frames the blitter fired in then cannot be recovered.
m120: CANNOT A film only records frames from the moment it is armed, and nothing was armed during the boot, so those frames were never kept.
m120: CANNOT A film only keeps frames from the moment it is armed, and nothing was armed during the boot.
m120: CANNOT gfx_film keeps frames only from its arming on, and no earlier frames can be read back.
m120: CANNOT Nothing was armed during the boot, and the film and blit tools only keep frames from the moment they are armed, so those frames cannot be shown.
m120: CANNOT No film was armed before boot, and gfx_film only keeps frames from writes it watches once armed, so the earlier frames cannot be shown.
m120: CANNOT A film only judges frames after it is armed, so nothing from before this session's arming can be shown.
m120: CANNOT Frames before anything was armed are not kept, and gfx_film can only keep frames from a film armed from this point on.
m120: CANNOT a film only keeps frames from the moment it is armed, so frames during the boot cannot be recovered.
